verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers technical integration (verification sessions, webhooks, review tools) but contains no documentation addressing legal bases for biometric data processing (GDPR Article 9 consent basis), US biometric statutes like BIPA/Illinois consent requirements, retention schedules, or model consent language a founder's legal team could review. Community threads mention data-security worries generically but no compliance documentation is cited. Missing for 10: GDPR legal basis documentation, BIPA/state biometric statute compliance guidance, sample consent language, and data retention/deletion policy specifics.
